edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the user key for userInfo and the token source in deposit
msg.sender identifies the withdrawing user in withdraw
msg.sender owns the NFTs enumerated and transferred in depositNFT
msg.sender is the destination for NFTs returned in withdrawNFT
dev requires msg.sender == devaddr to change the developer address
add requires msg.sender to be owner() or devaddr
set requires msg.sender to be owner() or devaddr
startFarming is protected by the onlyOwner modifier checking msg.sender
upgradeToAndCall is gated by the ifAdmin modifier comparing msg.sender to _admin()
deposit reads and updates userInfo[_pid][msg.sender] amount and rewardDebt
deposit reads and updates poolInfo[_pid] amount and accSushiPerShare
withdraw reads and decrements userInfo[_pid][msg.sender].amount
withdraw reads poolInfo[_pid] and decrements pool.amount
depositNFT registers tokenIds into userInfoNFTSet[_pid][msg.sender]
withdrawNFT reads and removes tokenIds from userInfoNFTSet[_pid][msg.sender]
deposit calls updatePool before computing rewards
withdraw calls updatePool before paying pending rewards
depositNFT calls updatePool before accruing rewards
withdrawNFT calls updatePool before paying pending rewards
massUpdatePools iterates and invokes updatePool for each pid
updatePool calls getMultiplier to compute the block reward multiplier
pendingSushi calls getMultiplier for off-chain reward projection
updatePool reads and halves sushiPerBlock on halving checks
getMultiplier performs subtract and multiply reward math against bonusEndBlock and BONUS_MULTIPLIER
withdraw sends pending rewards to msg.sender through safeSushiTransfer
deposit sends previously accrued rewards through safeSushiTransfer
depositNFT pays pending rewards through safeSushiTransfer
withdrawNFT pays pending rewards through safeSushiTransfer
safeSushiTransfer mints and transfers SUSHI to the external recipient before state settlement in callers
safeSushiTransfer operates on the sushi reward token state variable
withdraw pushes ETH/safeTransfer to msg.sender after updatePool but before rewardDebt is finalized
deposit executes an external token call pulling user LP tokens before user.amount is fully settled
depositNFT performs safeTransferFrom into the farm, invoking recipient hooks per NFT
withdrawNFT performs safeTransferFrom out to the user, calling onERC721Received on the caller
deposit wraps incoming ETH via IWETH.deposit when the pool token is WETH
withdraw unwraps WETH via IWETH.withdraw before sending ETH
dev overwrites the devaddr privileged state variable
startFarming sets the sushiPerBlock emission rate
startFarming flips mintStarted to true
startFarming records startBlock from block.number
startFarming computes bonusEndBlock = startBlock + 28800 * 20
add increases totalAllocPoint by the new allocation points
set recomputes totalAllocPoint when adjusting a pool allocation
_delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall forwarding msg.data to the implementation
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls attacker-influenced data against the updated implementation
